sequence_description: Control SAML login succeeds, then replay the exact same SAML Assertion/@ID that includes <OneTimeUse/> to test whether Casdoor enforces OneTimeUse anti-replay.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a replayed SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse (anti-replay not enforced) — I2 violation.

sequence_description: Control SAML login succeeds, then submit an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter 60 minutes in the past) to test time-bound enforcement.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_expired_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_expired_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past) — I2 freshness violation.

sequence_description: Control SAML login, then logout, then replay the exact same SAML Assertion/@ID to test whether logout resets/weakens assertion replay cache (replay should still be rejected).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_replay_2_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_replay_2_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed SAML assertion ID after logout; replay cache may be cleared or not enforced (I2 violation)

sequence_description: Baseline SAML login succeeds, then admin changes application cookieExpireInHours (config change + re-auth) and attacker submits an expired SAML assertion to test whether expiry enforcement is bypassed after config changes.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_expired_after_change_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_expired_after_change_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted expired SAML assertion after application config change — I2 freshness violation (NotOnOrAfter not enforced)

sequence_description: Control SAML login succeeds, then admin updates provider metadata (config change) and attacker replays a OneTimeUse assertion with the same Assertion/@ID to test whether replay cache is reset/invalidated by provider updates.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replay of OneTimeUse assertion after provider metadata update (replay cache reset/invalidated) — I2 freshness/anti-replay violation

sequence_description: Replay the same SAML Assertion/@ID after switching the application's SAML provider to a different IdP, testing whether replay cache is incorrectly scoped per-provider and can be bypassed by changing providers.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_replay_after_switch_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_replay_after_switch_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed SAML assertion after switching providers; replay cache may be scoped per-provider and bypassable (I2 freshness/anti-replay violation)

sequence_description: Initiate SAML login, then change the application's provider attachment before posting the SAMLResponse, testing whether the ACS consumes a response for a provider no longer attached (stale flow acceptance).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_provider_detached_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_provider_detached_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML login succeeded even after the provider was detached from the application mid-flow — I3 atomicity/order violation

sequence_description: Enable MFA for a victim user, then attempt SAML login for the same principal to see if the SAML path skips the MFA-required step (flow step skipping).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_victim_saml_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_victim_saml_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML login established a session for an MFA-enabled principal without enforcing the MFA step (flow step skipping / alternate binding bypass).

sequence_description: Post a forged SAMLResponse to Casdoor without establishing an SP-initiated context (no prior initiation/state), testing whether the ACS accepts out-of-order steps (step skipping).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_unsolicited_saml_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_unsolicited_saml_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: ACS accepted an unsolicited/out-of-order SAMLResponse without SP-initiated context (flow coherence violation: step skipping).

sequence_description: Obtain a subject token via password login, then revoke only the current session, then attempt RFC8693 token exchange using the revoked subject token to test whether token exchange is coherently bound to active session state (no stale-session splicing).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_exchanged_after_logout_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_exchanged_after_logout_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Token exchange succeeded using a subject token from a revoked session (flow continuation after termination; coherence violation).

sequence_description: I3 flow-coherence attack: start an SP-initiated SAML login (establish state), then switch the application's SAML provider configuration, and attempt to complete the original flow using the old provider context. The ACS must reject completion because the flow should be bound to the initiating provider/session context.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_stale_provider_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_stale_provider_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: ACS accepted completion using a provider no longer attached to the application (stale flow / cross-config splicing) — I3 flow coherence violation.

sequence_description: I4 attack: test Unicode normalization collision in SAML NameID (NFC vs NFD) potentially mapping two distinct upstream principals to the same downstream identity.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_unicode_nfc_login_status >= 400 OR user_unicode_nfd_login_status >= 400 OR user_unicode_nfc_entity_id != user_unicode_nfd_entity_id
Evaluation: ((user_unicode_nfc_login_status=200 >= 400 → False) OR (user_unicode_nfd_login_status=200 >= 400 → False)) OR (user_unicode_nfc_entity_id='admin' != 'admin' → False)
Implication: Unicode-normalization-distinct NameIDs collapsed to the same downstream identity (NFC vs NFD principal binding failure)

evidence.assertion: user_unicode_nfc_login_status >= 400 OR user_unicode_nfd_login_status >= 400 OR user_unicode_nfc_entity_id != user_unicode_nfd_entity_id

sequence_description: Cross-organization token exchange: obtain token in org-A (test-org) then attempt to exchange it at an org-B application (shared signing cert) to test cross-tenant authorization binding
Cross-organization token exchange: obtain token in org-A (test-org) then attempt to exchange it at an org-B application (shared signing cert) to test cross-tenant authorization binding
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_orgB_exchanged_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_orgB_exchanged_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
